en.t: Take care never to do anything that would make people laugh at you!"

units.source_text: 浮舟觉得这封信很奇怪，忧惧充塞胸中。

en.t: Ukifune thought this letter was very strange, and anxiety and fear filled her heart.

units.source_text: 如果表明理解此诗之意义而作复，实在难以为情；

en.t: If she replied in a way that showed she understood the meaning of the poem, it would be terribly embarrassing;

units.source_text: 如果说他言语怪僻，不能理解，则又不成样子。

en.t: but if she said his words were strange and she could not understand them, that too would be improper.

units.source_text: 于是把来信照原样折好，在上面添注数字：“此信恐系误送到此，故特退还。

en.t: So she folded the letter back just as it had been and added a few words on it: "I fear this letter may have been delivered here by mistake, and therefore I return it to you.

units.source_text: 今日身体异常不适，只字亦难奉复。”

en.t: Today I am feeling unusually unwell, and I cannot manage even a single word in reply."

units.source_text: 薰大将看了，想道：“应付得实在巧妙，想不到她这样机敏。”

en.t: When General Kaoru read it, he thought, "She handled this truly skillfully; I never imagined she was so quick-witted."

units.source_text: 他微微一笑，对她并无嫌恶之心。

en.t: He smiled faintly and felt no dislike for her at all.
